description: Judge how easily a domain's mail can be forged by correlating SPF and DMARC into one verdict: 'hardened' (DMARC enforcing), 'partial' (DMARC quarantine) or 'spoofable' (no DMARC or p=none — receivers won't reject forged mail), with an A–F grade and the concrete reasons. The controlling factor is DMARC: SPF alone doesn't stop a From: spoof. Read-only DNS.
name: spoofability
